evidence.field: File description; depicted form, source label, and reuse terms
evidence.text: The exact file page identifies 日-bronze.svg as a modern vector depiction of 日 in Western Zhou bronze-script style. It cites Xiaoxuetang form 32.EE8F and identifies the source artifact as 師虎簋, dated there to the mid Western Zhou. The page links the original SVG and states that the file is available under CC0. This is a modern redraw, not a photograph or scan of the bronze vessel.
evidence.title: File:日-bronze.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.text: The record labels 32.EE8F as a bronze-script form, names the source as 師虎簋, dates it to the mid Western Zhou, and gives the inscription catalogue number 集成4316. It displays 日 as the regular-script counterpart. These labels identify the candidate form and its database attribution; they do not make the displayed image a photograph of the artifact.
evidence.title: 小學堂字形

evidence.field: Official reuse notice for query-interface glyph images and glyph-attribute information
evidence.text: The notice states that glyph images and glyph-attribute information obtained through the site's query interface are offered under CC0 1.0. The notice concerns those queried assets and attributes; it does not grant blanket permission to reproduce the database or linked dictionary text.
evidence.title: 版權聲明 - 小學堂文字學資料庫

The exact Commons oracle file page was also opened, but that image URL was marked unavailable in the supplied acquisition findings and was excluded. The Commons original-image link for the bronze SVG was verified; the web tool could not render the SVG endpoint.
Search results exposed other 日 image filenames in the category. No additional file was selected without an inspected exact description page and confirmed provenance.

gaps: The selected candidate is a modern vector redraw of a form attributed to the mid Western Zhou 師虎簋, not an image of the vessel itself. The web tool confirmed the original SVG link but could not render the SVG endpoint; the image pixels have not been inspected in this research stage.

The exact Commons page for Shuowen Seal Radical 231.svg could not be opened, so its identity and licensing remain unverified. The oracle and seal image URLs identified as unavailable in the supplied acquisition findings were not retried.

items.period: Mid Western Zhou attribution for the underlying form; the selected file is a modern drawing.
items.tradition: Bronze inscription form; modern vector redraw.
items.caption: 日 in a bronze-script form attributed by Xiaoxuetang to the mid Western Zhou 師虎簋 (集成4316). This is a modern vector redraw, not a photograph of the vessel.
items.alt: Modern vector drawing of the 日 bronze-script form attributed to the mid Western Zhou 師虎簋.
items.selection_reason: Provides a sourced bronze-script example between the early inscriptional evidence and later script traditions. The Commons page gives the exact original image link, identifies its Xiaoxuetang source, and states CC0 reuse terms.
items.rights: CC0 1.0, as stated on the Commons file page; Xiaoxuetang query-interface glyph image and attribute data are also CC0 1.0 under its official notice.

limitations.text: The selected image is described by its source pages but its pixels were not inspected in this research stage. It is a modern redraw of an attributed bronze-script form, not an ancient artifact photograph.
